Hello, I am a postdoctoral researcher at ESSEC Paris under the supervision of Pierre Jacob.

Before that I was a postodoctoral researcher at Paris Dauphine under the supervision of Christian Robert.

Before that I was a PhD student at the University of Edinburgh under the supervision of Sotirios Sabanis.

I am interested probability, particularly the modelling of privacy, couplings, and the behaviour of SDEs in singular settings.
